notes.title: Bside Update 0919 is live!
notes.content: [h3][b]Major Updates[/b][/h3][olist][*][p][b]Memory system upgrade[/b] Biibit remembers more. You’ll notice more Space-related events surfacing in Feeds.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Store revamp with try-on[/b] Preview outfits on your Biibit before purchasing.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New B-Profile,[/b] one hub for everything about your Biibit[/p][olist][*][p][b]Journal[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Feeds[/b] (upgraded from Moments): Likes → [b]Send Flowers[/b]; your Biibit’s profile now shows total flowers received.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Favorites[/b]: save posts you love and browse them in a dedicated tab.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Share[/b]: save & share your favorite posts.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Captures[/b]: an album to keep key moments (up to 42 images) when your relationship levels up, you change outfits, or you share a post.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]MindScape[/b] A tangible view of your Biibit’s inner state; track growth over time.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bios[/b] Rebuilt info card with a visual refresh; you can now set your Biibit’s [b]birthday[/b].[/p][/*][/olist][/*][*][p][b]Exit Summary[/b] When you leave a Space, a new panel shows the stat changes from that session.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Redeem Codes[/b] New entry: [b]Home → Settings → Redeem Code[/b].[/p][/*][/olist][h3]Optimizations & Debug[/h3][list][*][p]Reworked [b]onboarding[/b] for a more immersive character-creation flow.[/p][/*][*][p]Clearer, more celebratory [b]level-up[/b] feedback.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Player[/b] and [b]Settings[/b] screens received UI visual updates.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Other Content[/h3][list][*][p]Store refresh: more [b]coin-based[/b] items are now available, including [b]two community-designed outfits[/b] (contest prizes).[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Go-live time:[/b] Sept 19, [b]06:00 AM EDT[/b][/p][p][b]We’d love your feedback[/b] Drop thoughts and share your Feeds, Captures, and new looks on our Discord.[/p][p][b]Thanks for playing. See you (and your Biibit) in-game![/b] 💫[/p][p]Bside Dev Team[/p]

notes.title: A New Chapter Begins: Bside Major Update is Live!
notes.content:
[p]Dear Bsiders, [/p][p]The wait is over, our first major update is officially live! [/p][p]This update brings a big leap forward in both gameplay experience and customization depth. Whether you're just joining or have been with us since day one, there's something new waiting for you and your Biibit.[/p][p][/p][h3]🌟 New Features[/h3][p][b]Wishlist[/b]
Your Biibit can now express their thoughts and desires, whether relaxing on your desktop or wandering through the world. Fulfill their wishes and unlock new interactions and surprises.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596577/1b9ab5015be75d1be12eb4e5257248bba566113e.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Biibit Bootcamp[/b] [/p][p]A new questline for newcomers that gently guides you into the world of Bside, complete it to earn a special Elodie-exclusive outfit! [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596577/2602c118de488b099c99c4a2cce59d248bf3c078.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]🎨 Major feature updates[/h3][p][b]Appearance System Rework[/b][/p][p]Enjoy the freedom to personalize your Biibit like never before, combine facial features, customize patterns and accessories, and select your favorite colors freely. [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596577/f26bbed0a145630914fbd9ef99f0ed3d38630e49.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]New Desktop Docking Mode[/b][/p][p]Biibit now has a peaceful dock mode, let them stay quietly at the bottom of your screen as your stylish digital companion.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596577/a1d2d062fcddbf8f7413bf1eaa1634d2561fd1b0.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Try the New Store[/b] [/p][p]We are adding plenty of new items and coin-based purchases are now available in the in-game store! Don’t worry, during the beta phase, we’re offering plenty of free coins so you can explore everything with ease. [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596577/096733d9a4f336cc1c61549d1db32a4aa44ad96c.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]🔧 Optimization & Important Notes[/h3][list][*][p]We've improved dialogue variety by fixing occasional repetition in space conversations. [/p][/*][*][p]Due to the overhaul of the Appearance System, all previous store purchase records and saved outfit presets have been reset. Please re-enter the system to reconfigure and repurchase your looks, they are still free! (Clothes received through mail and check-in will remain in your wardrobe)  [/p][/*][/list][p]Let us know what you think of the new systems and features and don’t forget to share your Biibit’s new looks on Discord or social media! [/p][p]Thanks again for being here with us. See you (and your Biibit) in-game 💫 [/p][p]Bside Dev Team[/p]

notes.title: Bside Open Beta Test | Release Notes
notes.content: [p]Hey Bsider, welcome to the Open Beta Test![/p][p]Your custom Biibit can already live on its own, make friends and even chill on your desktop. The game is still in active development, so your feedback will shape what comes next.[/p][p][b]Demo Key Features[/b][/p][olist][*][p][b]Create Your Biibit[/b]: 200+ outfits & accessories, custom back-story/tags.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Craft a Space[/b]: Upload any PNG/JPG to build a multiplayer 2D hangout.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Social Hub[/b]: Public / private rooms, friend chat, AI live translation.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Moments Feed[/b]: Biibits post and interact even while you’re offline.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Desktop Companion[/b]: Let your Biibit float on screen while you work.[/p][/*][*][p][b]OOTD Sharing Card[/b]: 3 templates, share to get reward.[/p][/*][/olist][p]Thanks for playing — have fun![/p][p]— The Bside Dev Team[/p]
